milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The soul torch is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 5) inside the corridor. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they found it. max_distance=5 ensures they are inside or at the entrance of the corridor, facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the torch.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown banner is at spawn-relative (-2, 1, 11) in the storage room at the end of the corridor. The player must navigate through the corridor to the room and face the banner. max_distance=5 ensures they are in or near the storage room, facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining purple concrete with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player needs the provided diamond pickaxe to mine purple concrete blocks from the storage room. At least 6 blocks must be mined to have enough material to build the animal pen in the next task, creating a genuine dependency.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because building an animal pen requires placing blocks as walls/enclosure. The player must place mined purple_concrete blocks in the open grassy area near the animals (spawn-relative area around -5, 0, -5). A generous box covers the pen building area. min_count=6 ensures a minimal enclosure structure has been built. This creates a true dependency on the mine_purple_concrete task.
